question: Should CodexBar intentionally disable background Claude CLI fallback and delegated expired-token repair for existing users whose stored prompt policy is `onlyOnUserAction`?
rationale: The restriction matches the documented no-background-prompt contract but changes established Auto fallback behavior, so maintainers must explicitly own that upgrade tradeoff.

options.title: Accept fail-closed background policy
options.body: Merge after end-to-end proof, accepting that restricted-policy users must use manual Refresh or login when background OAuth or CLI recovery is needed.

options.title: Preserve fallback after containment
options.body: Use a bounded timeout or cooldown design such as https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2163 to retain more automatic recovery after detecting a prompt-capable path.

options.title: Defer to shared credential policy
options.body: Pause the provider-specific change until https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2214 establishes a cross-provider contract.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed background policy
recommendation.body: Merge after end-to-end proof, accepting that restricted-policy users must use manual Refresh or login when background OAuth or CLI recovery is needed.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and calibrated the current background Claude auth-preflight behavior and its compatibility boundary.
